title: Arcane Wilds Persistent User Spells
description: Player-owned custom spells and disabled built-in default spell IDs stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\RSDragonwilds\Saved\Config\ArcaneWilds\user_spells.json so mod updates never overwrite user customizations.

disabledDefaults.description: List of built-in mod default spell IDs disabled by the player.

enabledDefaults.description: List of shipped-disabled built-in mod default spell IDs explicitly enabled by the player.

spells.description: Map of player-created custom spell IDs (cannot overwrite built-in default spell IDs).
